source: Archived GFS 48h forecasts → ERA5-Land reanalysis targets

notes: Training: 2024; validation: Jan–Jun 2025; interval calibration: Jul–Dec 2025; untouched test: Jan–Sep 2026.
10 plants excluded from fitting, normalization, and uncertainty calibration.
Heat baseline is the uncorrected 48-hour GFS forecast; soil baseline is training-period site median (global median for unseen plants).
All rainfall features are archived forecast estimates, not observed rainfall. Targets are reanalysis, not on-site measurements.
Intervals calibrated marginally on chronological calibration data; coverage is not guaranteed at every site.
